result_text:
I changed `averageOrderValueChangePercent()` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/model/YearOverYearSales.java`. It now returns null (empty) when the current month has no orders, so the false -100% no longer appears. I also updated its Javadoc to say so.

The existing check still returns null when last year had no orders. The revenue change and regions with orders in both years are untouched, so 20.00 to 40.00 still shows +100%. The full `mvn -o test` run passed. I didn't add a new test for the zero-orders case.
